# Bundled UI dependencies

The 0.15 UI navigation bundles the following MIT-licensed dependencies. Full notices are included under `ui/` and copied into the installed package at build time.

| Package | Version | Upstream |
|---|---|---|
| @astryxdesign/core | 0.7.15 | https://github.com/meta/astryx |
| @astryxdesign/theme-neutral | 0.7.15 | https://github.com/meta/astryx |
| @stylexjs/stylex | 0.19.2 | https://github.com/facebook/stylex |
| react / react-dom | 19.3.1 | https://github.com/facebook/react |
| scheduler | 0.28.0 | https://github.com/facebook/react |

Astryx Core and StyleX notices were retrieved from the official upstream repositories; Neutral, React, React DOM and Scheduler notices were copied from the installed npm packages. Existing AI skill notices remain in `skills/`. No model weights or font assets are bundled here.
